name: Chen's Empty Keg
summary: In Ratchet, Brewmaster Drohn turns to another recipe shared by Chen Stormstout. Trogg ale calls for rare organs and glands from beasts of the Barrens.

sections.title: A Second Pandaren Formula
sections.body: After helping Brewmaster Drohn recreate Chen Stormstout's first draught, you learn the wandering pandaren shared more than one brewing secret. Drohn has the formula for trogg ale, a strange brew made not from grain, but from potent parts of the wild beasts of central Kalimdor.

sections.title: The Ingredients of Trogg Ale
sections.body: To make trogg ale, Drohn needs lightning glands from stormhides, a thunderhawk saliva gland from greater thunderhawks, and a hearty liver from the plains' roaming kodos. Once distilled, these ingredients make a fiercely stimulating drink for life in the wilderness.

sections.title: An Enduring Partnership
sections.body: Brewmaster Drohn keeps the arrangement open for travelers and mercenaries passing through Ratchet. Bring him another supply of beast organs, and he is willing to brew more trogg ale.

faq.answer: Chen Stormstout is an elusive pandaren brewmaster who wandered across Kalimdor during the founding of Durotar. He shared some of his potent brewing methods with Drohn in Ratchet before continuing his travels.
Brewmaster Drohn is in Ratchet, the neutral port on the Barrens' eastern coast. He spends his days refining brews he learned from Chen.
Trogg ale is a potent brew Chen taught Drohn to make. It uses beast glands and organ meat in place of ordinary brewing hops, giving it a fierce kick for hardy adventurers.

faq.q: Where do you gather lightning glands?
faq.answer: You can gather lightning glands from stormhide beasts roaming the Barrens' arid lands. Their bodies carry natural electrical charges.

faq.q: What beasts drop thunderhawk saliva glands?
faq.answer: Greater thunderhawks provide the saliva glands Drohn needs. These avian predators hunt in the open skies across the Barrens.

faq.q: Can I brew trogg ale more than once?
faq.answer: Yes. Brewmaster Drohn will make more trogg ale when adventurers bring him fresh glands and a kodo liver.

angles.text: Trogg ale may offend culinary purists, but using rich organ meat and potent glands follows the frontier custom of wasting nothing from a kill.
As an orc, you may find Drohn's path unusual: he chose Chen's exotic brewing methods over the traditional warrior's path and keeps his business in Ratchet.
As a member of the Horde, you share a history with Chen Stormstout, who fought alongside the Horde in Durotar's defense. His time there left a lasting impression on orcs like Drohn.
